description_html: At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU!  Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers.  All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!      AI is moving faster than almost anything else in tech right now — and someone must make sure T-Mobile moves with it, safely. That's this team.  We're the engineering group deciding how new AI capability reaches the enterprise: which platforms and models get turned on, which agents are safe to keep running, and which ones need a fix before something goes wrong. Every new model, every new feature, and every agent built by every team at T-Mobile eventually runs through us. If you want to work on the infrastructure and guardrails behind AI at a company with 100M+ customers — not a side project, not a pilot, the real thing — this is that role.  We're hiring multiple AI Engineer positions; each pointed at a different piece of the puzzle.  Different focuses, same mission: make it possible for T-Mobile to move fast on AI without ever having to choose between speed and safety. Develop AI models to enhance customer service automation capabilities with measurable improvements  Apply prompt engineering and fine-tuning techniques to optimize AI system performance effectively  Create AI tools that support integration of AI-driven improvements into operational frameworks  Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure effective integration and functionality of AI systems  Design AI systems that improve interaction capabilities within complex service workflows  Contribute to strategic AI initiatives that advance organizational goals of customer satisfaction and efficiency  Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed      Knowledge, Skills and Abilities   :     Required:     Data Management/Data Modeling -  Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG); Vector Databases/Embeddings   Prompt Engineering  - LLM orchestration and RAG workflow design   Python -  LLM Orchestration Frameworks, e.g., LangChain, ADK   Cloud Computing -  RAG deployment, LLM application infrastructure, vector database/cloud AI services   Data Analysis    Model Tuning   Customer-Focused  Collaboration      Education and Work Experience   :     Required:     Bachelor's Degree  plus  3  years of related work experience OR advanced degree plus 1 year of related work experience.  Acceptable areas of study include Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science.   2+ years developing and deploying machine learning models,  including fine-tuning and prompt engineering.   2+ years experience with AI tools and software development using programming languages such as Python or R.    2+ years collaborating  with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into business workflows.      Licenses and Certifications :   Certified Analytics Professional (CAP): Certification that validates an individual's expertise in data analytics processes, including the ability to model and interpret complex data. (Preferred)  Machine Learning Certification: Certification demonstrating proficiency in machine learning techniques and applications, relevant for developing AI models. title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Enterprise Trust & Governance)
description_html:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The Enterprise Trust & Governance team builds the control plane that lets the world’s largest organizations deploy Perplexity broadly and with confidence. Computer and our agents work across a growing share of our customers’ environments, tools, and models. For administrators, that makes precise, enforceable control essential: who can do what, with which data, through which agents, and within what usage limits. This team makes those controls easy to manage, reliable and consistent across every product, and transparent to the people accountable for them.

This is a product and platform engineering role with end-to-end ownership, from shaping the architecture and policy models to shipping the experiences our customers’ administrators and security teams use every day. You’ll work across product and infrastructure teams to turn complex enterprise requirements into reusable primitives and intuitive controls. The scope spans identity and provisioning, fine-grained role-based access across connectors, tool actions, and models, customer-managed encryption keys, admin APIs, audit logs, and policy and usage controls. Strong governance helps enterprises move from pilots to company-wide rollouts and gives them the confidence to entrust agents with greater responsibility over time.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own enterprise identity and provisioning, including SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM, WorkOS integrations, and support for identity providers such as Okta and Microsoft Entra ID.

 - Build the permissions platform, with fine-grained roles and permissions for connectors, tool actions, models, and model effort levels, enforced consistently across products and agent workflows.

 - Design and ship secure, well-documented admin APIs for audit logs, members, groups, roles, and settings.

 - Build policy controls for model and feature availability, staged rollouts, model deprecations, usage and spend limits, alerts, and cost-center allocation.

 - Build admin-facing analytics for adoption, usage, spend, and policy enforcement, helping organizations measure value and manage their deployments.

 - Deliver audit logs and change notifications that help administrators investigate activity, track configuration changes, and support compliance.

 - Set the technical bar for authorization correctness and reliability, with fast, consistent, explainable permission checks, well-defined failure behavior, and strong tenant isolation.

 - Partner with Product, Design, Security, Sales, and Customer Success to translate complex enterprise requirements into reusable platform capabilities and intuitive admin experiences.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex backend systems from design through production operation.

 - Strong system design skills, including building reliable, scalable, multi-tenant SaaS platforms with clear security and isolation boundaries.

 - Strong proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, or Rust, and hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS and Kubernetes.

 - Deep expertise in at least one of the following:
   
   - Enterprise identity and provisioning, including OAuth, OIDC, SAML, and SCIM.
   
   - Permissions platforms, fine-grained authorization, and policy enforcement.
   
   - Encryption, customer-managed keys, and key lifecycle management.
   
   - Enterprise admin platforms, audit infrastructure, or usage and spend analytics.

 - Experience building or integrating enterprise identity and access systems, including platforms such as WorkOS, Okta, or Microsoft Entra ID.

 - Sound technical judgment in security-sensitive systems, balancing threat models, authorization correctness, and failure behavior with usability and delivery speed.

 - A track record of leading ambiguous, cross-team initiatives from architecture through adoption, setting technical direction for shared platforms, and raising engineering quality through mentorship.

If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification. We value demonstrated impact, deep ownership, and the initiative to turn ambiguity into results.
$220K – $405K • Offers Equity

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - AI Agent Platform
description_html: We are looking for a Sr. Engineer to design, build, and scale the infrastructure powering NVIDIA’s AI agent ecosystem. You will work at the intersection of distributed systems, developer platforms, and agentic AI — building the foundational services that enable teams across the company to develop, deploy, orchestrate, and operate autonomous AI agents at production scale.    What you will be doing:    Build and develop platform services that manage the full agent lifecycle from registration through deployment, execution, and teardown  Architect multi-tenant Kubernetes execution environments with pod lifecycle management, per-tenant namespace isolation, persistent storage, admission policy enforcement, and identity propagation  Develop and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI and ArgoCD, including reusable pipeline templates and deployment blueprints that standardize how agents are built across teams  Build framework-agnostic infrastructure supporting multiple agent SDKs and harnesses — lifecycle hooks, skills configuration, memory services, and OTEL instrumentation — so teams can onboard new agent frameworks without platform changes  Build and operate Kafka-based message pipelines and real-time event streaming using Redis PubSub and SSE  Develop data ingestion pipelines, access interfaces, and storage layers that power AI agent knowledge and context  Implement session management for state persistence, conversation history, and agent recovery across sessions  Develop multi-layer auth using OAuth 2.0, JWT validation, token exchange, and gateway integration, and manage secrets lifecycle with Vault (provisioning, rotation, container injection)  Partner with security teams on compliance, access controls, and approval workflows for agent operations     What we need to see:    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience), with 12+ years in software engineering — ideally in platform engineering, infrastructure, or developer tools  Experience building and scaling AI agents in production using frameworks like Claude Code, Codex, or LangGraph  Deep Kubernetes expertise including pod orchestration, persistent storage, RBAC, and multi-cluster management  Strong Python skills with production API experience using FastAPI, Flask, or similar async frameworks  Proven track record designing distributed systems with Kafka, Redis, and MongoDB or PostgreSQL  Expertise building and managing robust CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI and ArgoCD for continuous delivery to Kubernetes  Experience designing AI data platform components (ingestion pipelines, vector stores, retrieval APIs, data preprocessing workflows) and building developer-facing platform APIs consumed by multiple engineering teams  Solid grasp of auth and identity: OAuth 2.0, JWT, token exchange, and secrets management with Vault  History of leading sophisticated technical projects such as migrations or greenfield platform builds, with strong interpersonal skills to drive alignment across teams and write clear design documents     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Experience building or operating AI agent platforms or agentic workflow systems, with hands-on expertise in agent protocols and frameworks like MCP, A2A, LangChain, or LangGraph  Hands-on experience with RAG architectures, embedding pipelines, and vector databases (Milvus, Pinecone, or Weaviate)  Full-stack skills with React or Vue for building developer portals and dashboards  Contributions to open-source infrastructure or platform tooling      Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD for Level 5, and 248,000 USD - 391,000 USD for Level 6.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 20, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
